description.content:
Read-only REST API for the RockSolid liquid-vaults DeFi platform. It exposes the catalogue of RockSolid vaults with rich metadata (name, symbol, share and underlying-asset details, fees, curators, rewards, chain/platform info), latest performance data (per-share NAV, outstanding shares, estimated APR/APY, total assets), strategy allocation snapshots per allocation period, and calculated APR/TVL figures (with additional rETH-vs-ETH APR breakdowns for rETH vaults). The API is publicly readable and CORS-restricted to an allow list of origins; on-chain deposit/withdraw flows are handled directly against the ERC-7540 vault smart contracts (see the smart-contracts integration docs) rather than through this API. Faithfully transcribed by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline from the published RockSolid integration API docs and the live production endpoint.

Contact Support:
 Name: RockSolid
 Email: product@rocksolid.network
